question: To highlight the legacy of which governmental organisation was the first “Open-Air Art Wall Museum” at Mausam Bhawan inaugurated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India Meteorological Department (IMD).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Dr. Jitendra Singh inaugurated India’s first “Open-Air Art Wall Museum” at Mausam Bhawan, celebrating 150 years of the India Meteorological Department (IMD).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Jitendra Singh inaugurated the "Open-Air Art Wall Museum" at Mausam Bhawan, highlighting the 150-year legacy of IMD.**
 
• The museum features 38 murals showcasing the history and impact of IMD on weather forecasting, agriculture, and disaster management.
 
• Created in collaboration with Delhi Street Art, the project bridges the gap between science and creativity.
 
• The event emphasized IMD’s contributions to socio-economic development, particularly in sectors like agriculture and aviation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• India Meteorological Department (IMD)__

 __
 
• Founded: 1875
 
• HQ: New Delhi
 
• Key Role: Provides accurate weather forecasts, crucial for disaster management, agriculture, and more.
 
 
 
• Delhi Street Art__
 __
 
• Founder: Yogesh Saini
 
• Key Focus: Transforming urban spaces through artistic expressions.
 
 
 
• Mausam Bhawan__
 
 
• Location: Lodhi Road, New Delhi
 
• Purpose: Houses IMD’s headquarters and now hosts the first Open-Air Art Wall Museum.
